title: 连接共鞋ERP
description: 请填写当前ERP账号生成的MCP Token。凭证仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下。
description_en: Enter the MCP token generated for your ERP account. The credential is stored locally under ~/.workbuddy only.

fields.label: ERP MCP Token
fields.placeholder: 登录ERP后，在个人信息 → MCP接入中生成
fields.description: Token绑定当前ERP账号，并继承该账号的角色及数据权限。
fields.description_en: The token is bound to your ERP account and inherits its role and data permissions.
